# Why did my Pipedrive import go wrong?

> Free Pipedrive deals, people and organizations CSV checker: finds deals with a bad status, value or currency, missing names and titles, invalid and duplicate emails, Excel-damaged phone numbers, date format problems and probabilities written as fractions, with line numbers, and applies formatting-only safe fixes.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
